definitions.explanation: The gland in female mammals that produces milk. In medical Japanese, commonly encountered in discussions of breast cancer, breastfeeding, and women's health.

examples.japanese: {乳腺|にゅうせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: I had a mammary gland examination.

examples.japanese: {乳腺|にゅうせん}{外科|げか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受診|じゅしん}→受診：11890_jushin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ことにした。
examples.english: I decided to visit the breast surgery department.

examples.japanese: ⟦{授乳|じゅにゅう}{中|ちゅう}→授乳中：29228_junyuuchuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{乳腺|にゅうせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発達|はったつ}→発達：03559_hattatsu⟧し、⟦{母乳|ぼにゅう}→母乳：13237_bonyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{分泌|ぶんぴつ}→分泌：25492_bunpitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{活発|かっぱつ}→活発：13272_kappatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: During breastfeeding, the mammary glands develop and milk production becomes active.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{乳|にゅう}→乳：28296_nyuu⟧ (breast, milk) and ⟦{腺|せん}→腺：17997_sen⟧ (gland). An important medical term that Japanese women encounter regularly in health screenings and discussions about breast health. {乳腺|にゅうせん}{外科|げか} (breast surgery department) is a standard hospital department name.

Note: the homophone ⟦{入選|にゅうせん}→入選：11686_nyuusen⟧ (being selected/accepted, as in a contest) is a completely different word.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {乳腺|にゅうせん}{炎|えん}: mastitis (inflammation of the mammary gland)
- {乳腺|にゅうせん}{外科|げか}: breast surgery department
- {乳腺|にゅうせん}エコー: breast ultrasound
- {乳腺|にゅうせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発達|はったつ}→発達：03559_hattatsu⟧: development of mammary glands
- {乳腺|にゅうせん}{専門医|せんもんい}: breast specialist

RELATED WORDS:
- {乳|にゅう}がん ({乳癌|にゅうがん}): breast cancer — the most serious condition of the mammary glands
- ⟦{授乳|じゅにゅう}→授乳：14937_junyuu⟧: breastfeeding — the primary function of the mammary glands
- ⟦{腺|せん}→腺：17997_sen⟧: gland — the general anatomical term (⟦{甲状腺|こうじょうせん}→甲状腺：23860_koujousen⟧, ⟦{唾液腺|だえきせん}→唾液腺：27747_daekisen⟧, etc.)
